data.title: Rect select with copy/paste (floating paste, both modes)

data.body:
Implementation complete (4 commits: 168b0c3 marquee, 1a0d77d copy/cut/delete, 909582e float, 43b1066 polish). npx tsc --noEmit + npm run build green after every step; git tree clean.

WHAT LANDED — per the plan: new src/state/selection.ts (DOM-free: SelRect/Float/SelectionState, copyRect/eraseRect/stampFloat via getViewPx/plotView, clampFloatPos), new src/tools/select.ts (passive + clampToWindow, marquee + float drag + click-outside-commits), dirtySel in the store, opt-in Tool flags + 5 ToolContext selection methods, grid-editor (sel dep, toPt window clamp, bumpForTool routing, clearRect-then-drawImage float compositing, ants), chrome.drawMarquee (static two-tone 1-device-px hairline), main.ts (clipboard + 8 actions + keyboard precedence + stamp-on-context-change), toolbar icon, LCD sel segment. doc.ts/history.ts/persist.ts/raster/preview/export/other tools/app.css untouched, as specified. No new deps.

SMOKE (throwaway node harness over the compiled pure module, not committed): 22/22 assertions pass — border multi-cell copy returns transparent for locked-centre pixels; erase writes 0 (transparency, not paper) and is bounded; stamp is verbatim (transparent float pixels punch holes); cut→stamp round-trips the sheet byte-for-byte; stamp clips the locked centre and off-sheet; tile copy across a cell seam reads the wrapped content; tile stamp wraps (incl. view coords beyond the tile, and wider-than-C last-write-wins); clampFloatPos (inside/pinned/focused-window/oversized-pins-to-origin); rectFromPoints; cropTopLeft.

ACCEPTANCE (code-verified = harness or provable by construction; browser = needs a real pointer/paint):
1 marquee/click-deselect/LCD — browser (registry, hotkey m, icon, LCD segment code-verified).
2 border multi-cell copy, locked centre transparent — CODE-VERIFIED.
3 cut leaves transparency, one undo step, selection survives — CODE-VERIFIED (erase→0; exactly one history.push per action); keystroke path browser.
4 paste floats/drag/nudge/never leaves the window — clampFloatPos CODE-VERIFIED; rest browser.
5 stamp one undo entry + re-selects stamped bounds — CODE-VERIFIED by construction; browser.
6 cancel keeps the doc + clipboard; undo while floating drops the float — code-read; browser.
7 tile torus copy/stamp wrap — CODE-VERIFIED; 'no preview/autosave churn during drags' CODE-VERIFIED by construction (passive tools bump dirtySel only; the debouncer and autosave subscribe to dirtyDoc/dirtyPreview) — observe in browser.
8 border clipping on stamp — CODE-VERIFIED.
9 Esc precedence float→rect→focus, never swallowed idle — code-read; browser.
10 focus interplay (window clamp, centred paste, exit-on-doesn't-fit, stamp on enter/exit/mode/tool/cell) — code-read; browser.
11 no regressions — typecheck+build green, passive/clampToWindow are opt-in and every non-select pointer path is byte-identical; browser sweep of the seven tools still needed.
12 brand audit — CODE-VERIFIED for substance (only #FF4E00/#FBFAF8 in the ants, no CSS changes, lowercase deadpan copy, nothing animates); visual check browser.

DEVIATIONS (all small, all deliberate):
a. selection.ts exports two helpers beyond the plan's list: rectFromPoints (marquee normalization — keeps the math in the pure module) and cropTopLeft (the plan's 'clip the pasted buffer to LxL' rule needed a crop and raster/buffer.ts is off-limits).
b. moveFocus now clears the marked rect. The plan said 'no change needed', but that line is about floats; moveFocus changes the window exactly like enter/exitFocus, and a rect left behind in another cell would be invisible yet still live for copy/cut.
c. Ants clip is the art rect inflated by 1 device px (the width the ants sit outside the marked pixels) so an edge-to-edge marquee still shows its hairline instead of being clipped to nothing. A rect outside the window still cannot paint the letterbox.
d. Pasting while a float is live stamps the existing float first (plan didn't specify; consistent with stamp-on-context-change).
e. Delete/Backspace calls preventDefault when it acts (stops browser back-navigation).
f. drawMarquee(ctx,x,y,w,h,z) takes window-local LOGICAL coords + zoom; the plan's prose showed pre-multiplied device px in the call site while the signature carried z. Same geometry either way.

KNOWN GAP for the reviewer to rule on (out of the plan's scope, not fixed): png/css export, save and autosave do not stamp a live float — the float is not part of the document until stamped (it never bumps dirtyDoc), which is coherent but means exporting mid-paste omits what is on screen.
